units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 6">Gen. R. s. 6</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 48:14">Gen. XLVIII, 14</cite>) <he>וכי … שהוא הצ׳</he> do we not know from the genealogical records that he was the younger?—Pl. <he>צְעִירִים</he>.

Arakh. II, 6 (13ᵇ) וצְעִירֵי הלוים וכ׳ Ar. a. Maim. (Mish. וצוֹעְרי; Bab. ed. וצערי Rashi וצוע׳) and they were called the junior Levites; ib. 13ᵇ תנא וסועדי … ותנא דידן … קרי להו צערי there is a version, ‘and they were called the assistants of the Levites’; and as to our version (צעירי or צוערי), because the voices of those were fine …, therefore he calls them tsa’ăré (the troubles) of the Levites (v. צַעַר).
Gen. R. s. 75 צְעִירֵיהֶם של שבטים the youngest of the tribes; a. e.—Fem. צְעִירָה.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 38b:6">B. Kam. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>צ׳ דקאמרה בן עמי וכ׳</he> the younger (daughter of Lot) that called her son Ben-ammi &c.; <cite ref="Horayot 11a:1">Hor. 11ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Nazir 23b:12">Naz. 23ᵇ</cite>; a. e.—

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Megillah 1:9:15">Y. Meg. I, 71ᵈ</cite> bot. <he>כתבו לו … צְעִירַת הרגלים</he> they (the Greek translators) wrote for him (Ptolemy) ‘the slender-footed’ (in place of <cite ref="A03195"><he>ארנבת</he></cite>, <cite ref="Leviticus 11:6">Lev. XI, 6</cite>); Bab.

<cite ref="Megillah 9b:3">Meg. 9ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Tractate Soferim 1:8">Treat. Sof’rim I, 8</cite>; Mekh. Bo, s. 14; Tanḥ. Sh’moth 22.—[LXX <cite ref="Leviticus 11:5">Lev. XI, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Leviticus 11:6">6</cite> has δασύποδα = <he>שְׂעִירַת הרגלים</he>.]
